text:
maya: quick heads-up: prototyping an evict->flowback pattern. instead of blind evict, emit an event admission can consume so it can reshape (smaller microbatch, divert to fallback model, etc). want early thoughts before RFC.

rahul: ok. why flowback vs stronger eviction TTL? worried about oscillations.

maya: main goals: 1) reduce evict->reload churn that thrashes KV warming, 2) let admission make SLA-aware choices, 3) avoid blind LRU across mixed slabs.

lucas: KV warmup cost is the big risk. won't this just move cache pain earlier? how to avoid shifting the tail?

maya: plan: add warm_grace + hysteresis + dampening on flowback. flowback carries {tenant, reason, last_warm_ts, deadline_hint}. admission logic uses slab and hint. pseudo:

```
emit_flowback(ev) // tenant, warm_ts, hint
on_flowback(f) {
  s = slab_for(f.tenant)
  if s.premium && now - f.warm_ts < WARM_GRACE: ignore
  else if f.hint < SLAB_THRESH: divert_small_batch()
  else accept_normal()
}
```

anya: SLA surface: premium routes must be deterministic. no silent diverting. need explicit degrade policy.

maya: agreed. premium slabs: no redirect unless explicit canary degrade. mid slabs: probabilistic divert + notification. console knobs: preemptive_divert toggle, headroom tokens.

rahul: metrics to add for proto: flowback_rate, rewarm_rate, kv_miss_delta, p95/p99 per slab, fairness_jain, tenant_toggle_rate.

lucas: rollout: internal-only, 1% hosts, synthetic hot tenants. add kill switch to drop flowback if thrash.

ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled canary for branch "evict-flowback/proto" to staging at 2024-04-12T15:00Z :rocket:

maya: testplan: hot-tenant steady stream, mixed bursts, premium under pressure. targets: rewarm overhead <10%, p95 premium <= +5%. volunteers?

anya: I can own SLA contract + console copy.

rahul: i'll own metrics + alerts (oscillation alarm + kv miss spike).

lucas: i'll create synthetic harness and run warm/cold migration tests.

maya: thanks team. i'll drop a tiny RFC in design docs and land an observe-only proto first (emit flowback, no-op consumer). iterate from metrics. tl;dr: flowback gives admission SLA context, but must have warm_grace/hysteresis and careful rollout. :white_check_mark:
